channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: AgentENV
item.description: AgentENV is a distributed platform for running and scaling agent environments, enabling the deployment of AI agents across various systems. — It provides infrastructure for large-scale agent operations, addressing the challenge of deploying and managing multiple AI agents in complex, distributed settings.

item.title: Alibaba Open-Code-Review
item.description: Alibaba Open-Code-Review is a hybrid architecture tool combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent for precise code review comments. — It enhances code quality and security by integrating AI-driven analysis with fine-tuned rulesets, offering an advanced solution beyond basic AI coding assistants.

item.title: Heard
item.description: Heard is a macOS voice layer that provides intelligent audio summaries of agentic workflow output from tools like Claude Code and Cursor. — It allows developers to monitor parallel coding agents through audio, providing project-level summaries without needing constant visual attention, unlike traditional terminal outputs.

item.title: Codex CLI
item.description: Codex CLI is an open-source AI coding agent from OpenAI that operates directly within the terminal for code generation, bug fixes, and refactoring. — It offers a lightweight, sandboxed alternative to full IDE integrations like Cursor, providing terminal-first AI assistance without leaving the command line.

item.title: Bolna Agent Studio
item.description: Bolna Agent Studio is a framework designed for quickly building and deploying voice AI agents. — It streamlines the creation of voice-enabled agents, offering a specialized solution compared to general agent frameworks that require more manual audio integration.

item.title: RAGFlow
item.description: RAGFlow is an open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine designed to provide large language models with a more reliable context layer. — It offers a comprehensive solution for document parsing, data cleaning, and retrieval enhancement, crucial for building robust AI agents that need to look up external information reliably.

item.title: OrchestrAI
item.description: OrchestrAI is an AI Agent Operating System enabling enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, and continuously improve coordinated AI agents through semantic infrastructure. — It addresses the scalability challenges of managing numerous AI agents by providing a meta-agent for autonomous deployment, orchestration, and continuous improvement, offering a centralized view of agent infrastructure.

item.title: PlugThis
item.description: PlugThis enables users to create custom Chrome extensions by describing desired functionality through natural language prompts. — This tool democratizes browser customization, allowing non-developers to rapidly build and deploy utility-focused mini-applications without coding.
